name: Facet
text: Make the timeline a fixed-height strip at the top, always visible, with a subtle vertical line marking the current playback position. This keeps the user oriented without stealing screen space from the main view. The trade-off is less vertical room for content, but the clarity and speed of screwing around outweigh that cost.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A fixed-height strip buries decaying decisions under fresh noise—users scroll past the mark without seeing it. Better: a floating, dismissible banner that appears only when the playback drifts off-screen; it settles the argument by measuring how often users reorient after the strip fails.
